summary: Web-only test for PublicHomeNewLookV2 preserve-intent + station preview + landing analytics + admin analytics page. 8/8 backend tests pass. Web UI flows verified: (a) Create My Radio + Dining CTAs correctly set rl_intent and round-trip through /login → destination for premium@ user; intent is cleared post-login. (b) Station preview bar appears on click and gracefully surfaces the 'Preview ended — sign in to keep listening' state when audio playback fails (autoplay blocked in headless Chromium). (c) Landing-event POSTs are captured anonymously; admin /admin/landing-analytics renders total events / preview_plays / Top CTAs / Top Sections aggregated from live data. (d) AdminHome quicklink 'admin-home-ql-landing' navigates to the page. (e) Regression: anon public-home-v2 renders; logged-in shell-v2 + home-new-look-v2 both mount. Found ONE bug: public-preview-close does not actually hide the preview bar when it is in the 'preview ended' state (stopPreview only clears previewId, not previewEnded/previewStation).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking public-preview-close does NOT hide the preview bar when the bar is in the 'preview ended' state. The bar renders while `previewStation && (previewId || previewEnded)`, but `stopPreview()` only calls `setPreviewId(null)` — it never resets `previewEnded` or `previewStation`. Result: after a failed / 30s-completed preview, tapping the X visually leaves the bar on screen (the spec says close should stop AND hide). Reference: /app/frontend/src/design_v2/PublicHomeNewLookV2.jsx:89-93 and render guard line 452. Fix: in stopPreview, also `setPreviewEnded(false); setPreviewStation(null);` (or the close handler should do so).

critical_code_review_comments: PublicHomeNewLookV2.jsx is ~610 lines and includes multiple sub-components (PublicNav / SectionHeader / StationCard / PreviewSection / B2BCard / PublicFooter) — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting sub-components to a folder if the page grows further.

Landing analytics endpoint `/api/shell/landing-event` correctly enforces an allowlist and is anon-friendly; `/api/shell/landing-analytics` correctly returns 403 for non-admin (verified). Aggregation uses `$addToSet` on session_id which is bounded to top 50 keys — fine for now but will grow unbounded per-key; consider a TTL / cap on session sets long-term.

utils/intent.js consumeIntent uses a module-level cached singleton — that's the right fix for post-auth navigate races, but it also means intent survives a route change until a full page reload. Not a bug for this flow, but worth documenting.

rca of the issue: public-preview-close bug: `stopPreview` in PublicHomeNewLookV2.jsx only calls `setPreviewId(null)`. The bar render guard is `previewStation && (previewId || previewEnded)`. If the preview transitioned into the 'ended' state (either the 30s timer fired or `.play()` was rejected — which is common in headless / autoplay-blocked contexts), `previewEnded` remains `true` and `previewStation` remains set → the bar stays on screen after the X is clicked. Reproduction: (1) go to /, (2) click any station whose stream fails to autoplay OR wait 30s after a real play, (3) click the X — the bar remains visible with 'Preview ended — sign in to keep listening'. Fix: extend stopPreview to also reset previewEnded and previewStation, OR give public-preview-close a dedicated handler that clears all three.
